neighbours.label: the verb 'mingle' (mingled, mingles)
fire: At the festival he mingled with fans and signed autographs.
Her tears mingled with his as they said goodbye.
The scent of pine mingled with smoke from the fire.
Guests were invited to mingle before the dinner began.
In the old story the god mingles freely with mortals.
Dried apples hung on the walls, mingled with red peppers.
The minister toured the region and mingled with settlers.
Laughter mingles with music in the crowded square.
